summary: The candidate fixes the reviewed DP-attention direct-linker counterexample and adds the requested one-client-per-directory documentation, but it does not fulfill its broader every-client isolation claim. The registered direct linker uses only attn_dp_rank, tp_rank, and pp_rank: pure-DP replicas all have attn_dp_rank 0, and attention-CP rank is omitted. Independent fixtures therefore still produce identical Mooncake LOCAL_DISK directories for those distinct clients.

tests.what_was_measured: On base 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365, two clients with identical attention-local TP/PP identity both passed the same configured SSD directory, reproducing the collision precondition. The README also had no one-client-per-directory statement.
All four candidate regressions passed, including propagation of attention DP rank and DP/TP/PP path namespacing.

The imported registered direct-linker helper generated distinct rank_0_0_0 and rank_1_0_0 directories for two DP-attention workers; independent TP and PP boundary cases also remained distinct and directories were created.
Two pure-DP replicas both selected rank_0_0_0 because attn_dp_rank is 0 for every pure-DP worker; two attention-CP workers also both selected rank_0_0_0 because attn_cp_rank is not represented.
Fifteen adjacent Mooncake unit tests passed.

gpu_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, and HIP 7.2 were visible. No GPU execution is claimed because the reviewed defect is deterministic Python rank propagation and filesystem path selection; GPU execution would not establish directory uniqueness.
native_rebuild_evidence: The candidate diff contains no C, C++, CUDA, HIP, header, or other native source changes. Python imports resolved to /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/hicache_storage.py and /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/storage/mooncake_store/mooncake_direct_linker.py, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
remaining_counterexamples: Registered MooncakeDirectLinker under pure data parallelism: distinct replicas have attn_dp_rank == 0 and identical local tp_rank/pp_rank, so they still select the same rank_0_0_0 directory when sharing the configured base path.
Registered MooncakeDirectLinker under attention context parallelism: distinct attn_cp_rank workers are not distinguished by the rank_<dp>_<tp>_<pp> layout and can select the same final directory.
remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Flash weights and the reported TP8 distributed deployment were unavailable; no full-model or multi-node run is claimed.
No live Mooncake master with simultaneous LOCAL_DISK clients was run. The tests directly validate SGLang's setup path collision precondition, not downstream bucket corruption or restart recovery.
The Mooncake-side recovery/ownership change referenced by the issue is outside this repository and was not qualified.
The available gfx950 GPU was not needed for this Python configuration/path defect and was not used as substitute evidence.
